question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 21 days and B can do the same job in 15 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 2 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM of (21, 15, 2) = 210 units.

Efficiency of A = 210 ÷ 21 = 10 units/day.

Efficiency of B = 210 ÷ 15 = 14 units/day.

Combined Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 210 ÷ 2 = 105 units/day.

Time for C = 210 ÷ (105 − 10 − 14) = 210 ÷ 81 = 70 ÷ 27 = 2¹⁶/₂₇ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 2¹⁶/₂₇ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 21 days

Time taken by B = 15 days

Time taken by A, B, and C together = 2 days

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of A = 10 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 14 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of A + B + C = 105 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of C = Efficiency of (A + B + C) − Efficiency of A − Efficiency of B

⇒ Efficiency of C = 105 − 10 − 14 = 81 units/day

⇒ Time taken by C alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C

⇒ Time taken by C alone = 210 ÷ 81

⇒ Time taken by C alone = 70 ÷ 27 = 2¹⁶/₂₇ days

**∴ The correct answer is 2¹⁶/₂₇ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Works exactly like Time & Work. Filling pipes have a positive efficiency, and emptying pipes (leaks) have a negative efficiency.

Work & Wages

Wages are distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each person. If they work for the same number of days, wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their individual efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

When persons work on alternate days, find the work done in one complete cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 persons). Then find the closest multiple to the total work before calculating the final remaining days.
